**Pocket ID** ([website](https://pocket-id.org/)) provides a simple Open ID Connector based on *passkeys*.

## Sample config

This a basic config using <a href="sops-nix" class="wikilink" title="sops-nix">sops-nix</a> ([repo](https://github.com/mic92/sops-nix)) to store the encryption key.
